title: Depth-Aware Activation Steering via Attention Residuals
abstract: arXiv:2611.21655v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation steering is a simple, training-free way to modulate LLM behavior, yet existing methods typically inject vectors at a single layer and lack mechanisms for depth-aware propagation or internal verification. We combine two recent ideas - Attention Residuals (AttnRes) providing learnable cross-layer pathways, and Jacobian-lens (J-space) concept readout - into a lightweight depth-aware steering pipeline. On two small open models (Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3.5-0.8B), distributing a persona vector according to AttnRes-style depth weights yields stronger internal alignment (deeper-layer concept cosine and rank, p<0.0001) and stronger behavioral shifts than single-layer injection. The effect is sign-specific: reverse vectors invert all six metrics, random directions degrade alignment (p<0.0001), and a short LoRA fine-tune erases the imprint. Injection rewires attention strictly downstream of the injection point (upstream JS = 0.00000). Three

translated_title: 基于注意力残差的深度感知激活引导
translated_abstract: 激活引导是一种简单、无需训练的调节大语言模型行为的方法，然而现有方法通常仅在单一层注入向量，缺乏深度感知传播或内部验证机制。我们将两个近期的研究思路——提供可学习跨层通路的注意力残差，以及Jacobian透镜（J空间）概念读出——结合为一个轻量级的深度感知引导流水线。在两个小型开源模型（Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3.5-0.8B）上，按照AttnRes式深度权重分布人格向量，相比单层注入产生了更强的内部对齐（更深层概念余弦相似度和排名，p<0.0001）以及更强的行为转变。该效应具有符号特异性：反向向量会使全部六个指标发生反转，随机方向则会降低对齐程度（p<0.0001），而短暂的LoRA微调会抹除这种印记。注入仅在注入点的严格下游重新连接注意力（上游JS = 0.00000）。……
tldr: 该论文提出将注意力残差与Jacobian透镜概念读出相结合的深度感知激活引导方法，通过按深度权重跨层分布人格向量，实现比单层注入更强的内部概念对齐与行为转变效果。
en_tdlr: The paper combines Attention Residuals with Jacobian-lens concept readout into a lightweight depth-aware activation steering pipeline, showing that distributing persona vectors across layers via AttnRes-style depth weights yields stronger internal alignment and behavioral shifts than single-layer injection.
